comment: Story S2 (Option-Y-Korrektur) — Karpathy profile, Outputs layer. Frage-Report (Frage + Quellen + Antwort). Lives in the `Outputs` folder of the karpathy profile. Pflichtfelder: id, type, title, created, updated, question, sources (min 1, Klartext-Referenzen auf RAW/Wiki). `stand` optional.
